lens: Recompute every printed number from the artifact that produces it — percentages against numerator and denominator, totals against their parts, counts against the actual length or labelled subset of the list they count, n against the n the code used after filtering, and every fold-change, mean and range. Newly added tables and newly printed statistics first; counts of the paper's own search and curation record included.
what_i_read: research/modalities/atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json (§8: cohort, identity check, mechanism paper, fetch_status)
git show 12e44660c / ce630e2b4 of emc-atr-vulnerability.json (the two superseded snapshots the Appendix quotes); git log of a07235aef
central_claim: The FET-fusion → impaired-ATM → compensatory-ATR hypothesis is internally consistent only weakly in public data and does not transfer cleanly to EMC: part A finds the DepMap 'EMC' line is recorded as fusion-negative, part B grades WEAK (DDR transcripts elevated only as far as generic proliferation, on two independent series), part C finds the CRISPR knockout readout blind even against a matched sarcoma comparator, and part D finds 1 of 4 pre-registered mechanism tests passing — with §8 adding a competing HRD-based ATR programme in sarcoma.

p1s.summary: §3.0a prints '25 EMC-titled SAMPLE records' (and, twenty lines below, 'the 25 EMC-titled GSMs'). 25 is the LENGTH OF THE LIST; the artifact's own labelled subset is 11. Exactly the defect class of quoting a list length where the artifact separates a labelled subset.
p1s.evidence: Line 285, table row 'NCBI GEO DataSets | 5 ... | 35 UIDs → 10 series, plus 25 EMC-titled SAMPLE records'; and line 307, 'GEO's DataSets summaries for the 25 EMC-titled GSMs came back with an empty series field'. Recomputed from emc-atr-vulnerability.json#part_b_emc_tumour_signature.dataset_search.geo.samples: len(samples) = 25, sum(1 for s in samples if s['is_emc_titled']) = 11 — GSM600934, 600935, 600936, 600937, 600938, 600939, GSM715466, GSM715467, GSM715470, GSM715472, GSM9037837. The other 14 carry is_emc_titled: false and are not EMC-titled: GSM1067329 ('Sample 168-97'), GSM1672228/229/230/234/235/236/237/238/239/240/241/242 (twelve 'Rh30_siNR4A…' knockdown samples) and GSM2113301 ('V1-34'). The 'empty series field' half of line 307 IS true of all 25 (every row has series: []), so only the 'EMC-titled' qualifier is wrong. §3.0's own narrative depends on the smaller number: the samples it says 'nothing followed up' are exactly the 10 GSMs in GSE24369/GSE28866 plus the later GSM9037837.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: '25 SAMPLE records, 11 of them EMC-titled' at line 285 and 'the 25 GSMs' at line 307 fix it. Re-labelling any of the 14 knockdown/other rows as EMC-titled, or dropping the is_emc_titled field from the artifact, would break the count again.

p1s.summary: The Bangerter reference is printed with year 2022; the repository's own bibliographic record and this document's own Europe PMC cache both say 2023. Volume and pages are right.
p1s.evidence: Lines 210-212 (§2.2) and line 926 (Appendix) both print 'Bangerter et al., *Hum Cell* 2022;36:446-455, PMID 36316541, doi:10.1007/s13577-022-00818-x'. research/literature/submission-reference-metadata-2026-08-09.json entry '36316541' records: journal 'Human cell', journal_abbrev 'Hum Cell', year 2023, volume '36', issue '1', pages '446-455', doi '10.1007/s13577-022-00818-x', pmcid PMC9813045. The assessment's own artifact agrees: emc-atr-vulnerability.json#part_a_hemcss_identity.literature.results['"H-EMC-SS"'].rows entry for pmid 36316541 gives year '2023'. Six other artifacts in the repo write it as 'Hum Cell 36:446-455 (2023)' (e.g. research/modalities/noncoding-acceptor/aso-insilico-evaluation-e13n2-deep500.json, research/modalities/emc_model_junction_evidence.py line 192). The '2022' matches only the DOI's own year segment (s13577-**022**-00818-x). This is the citation that carries §2.2's only sourced epidemiological bound ('> 90 % of the cases an NR4A3 rearrangement'), the sentence that stops §2.2 reading as a reclassification of a real cell line.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Changing both occurrences to 'Hum Cell 2023;36(1):446-455' matches every committed record. Any edit that keeps 2022 while citing PMID 36316541 reintroduces the conflict with submission-reference-metadata-2026-08-09.json.

p2s.summary: §3.0a prints the broad BioStudies NR4A3 query as returning 10,332; the artifact records 10,331. Off by one.
p2s.evidence: Line 287: 'the broad NR4A3 query returns 10,332 and is not usable as a filter'. emc-atr-vulnerability.json#part_b_emc_tumour_signature.dataset_search.biostudies.total_per_query = {'"extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma"': 37, 'NR4A3 sarcoma': 10331}. The 37 in the same table cell is exact. The Appendix already carries one off-by-one row of this class ('27,195' vs n_probes_mapped_to_symbols 27196), which I confirmed: git show ce630e2b4 gives 27195, the pinned artifact gives 27196.

p2s.summary: §3.0a calls the GEO result '10 series'; the artifact's list of 10 contains 8 GSE series plus one GDS DataSet and one GPL platform record.
p2s.evidence: Line 285. dataset_search.geo.series keys = GDS3481, GPL570, GSE11185, GSE24369, GSE28866, GSE299349, GSE4303, GSE43632, GSE68458, GSE80126. GPL570 is the HG-U133_Plus_2 platform record (its n_samples field reads 177506) and GDS3481 is a curated DataSet, not a series. The count of 10 is faithful to the artifact's list length; the noun is not. n_uids = 35 checks exactly.

p2s.summary: §3.1's enumeration of GSE4303's classified samples names 22 of the 27 it totals — the five DFSP on GPL3288 and GPL3289 are never mentioned.
p2s.evidence: Line 321: '10 EMC tumours sit together on GPL3290, beside 3 GIST and 3 DFSP on the same print run, with 4 MFH/UPS on GPL3254 and 2 more GIST on GPL3335 — 27 classified samples in total'. 10+3+3+4+2 = 22. The total of 27 is correct: series_readability.GSE4303.class_counts = {unclassified 9, MFH_UPS 4, DFSP 8, EMC 10, GIST 5}, i.e. 27 classified. The missing 5 are per_platform GSE4303-GPL3288 (DFSP 2) and GSE4303-GPL3289 (DFSP 3). A reader adding the named parts lands 5 short of the stated total.

p2s.summary: §4 calls 0.190 a 'within-group SD'; the artifact field is the SD of the whole sarcoma pool (FET lines and matched comparator together).
p2s.evidence: Line 510: 'a FET-minus-matched delta of −0.0065 against a within-group SD of 0.190'. part_c_coordinated_dependency.knockout_instrument_with_matched_comparator.axis_sd_sarcoma_pool = 0.1904, and its own _criterion describes the comparison as 'the between-group delta is smaller than the within-group SD' while computing the SD over the pool. Value transcribed correctly; the label mixes within- and between-group variance. (delta_FET_minus_matched = −0.0065 and axis_mean_sarcoma_pool = −1.34 both check exactly.)

p2s.summary: §4 attributes '99.2–100 % of lines dependent' to the sarcoma pool; the two values quoted are the PANEL-WIDE fractions, and the artifact carries a separate sarcoma-pool figure.
p2s.evidence: Line 508-509: 'the axis sits at the floor in *both* groups — mean −1.340 across the sarcoma pool, 99.2–100 % of lines "dependent" on ATR and CHEK1'. 0.992 and 1.0 are per_gene['ATR'].frac_dependent_panel_wide and per_gene['CHEK1'].frac_dependent_panel_wide — computed over the whole DepMap panel, not the 91-line sarcoma pool. The sarcoma-pool figure exists separately as knockout_instrument_with_matched_comparator.frac_lines_dependent_on_axis_sarcoma_pool = 1.0. The −1.340 in the same sentence IS the sarcoma pool (axis_mean_sarcoma_pool). Both numbers are transcribed correctly; one clause attaches the wrong population to two of them.

p2s.summary: §3.2a's '0–9 members' understates the floor: the minimum gene-set membership in the superseded snapshot is 1, not 0.
p2s.evidence: Line 380: 'At a 1.0 % accession yield, 662 of 41,614 probes map and every gene set is left with 0–9 members'. git show 12e44660c of emc-atr-vulnerability.json, per_platform['GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz'].n_geneset_genes_matched = {ATM 2, ATR_CHK1 2, replication_stress 1, stalled_fork 1, S_phase 5, checkpoint 2, MYC 3, mitotic 9, myogenesis 6, adipogenesis 6, oxphos 2, generic_DNA_repair 1} — min 1, max 9. Across all seven GSE4303 platforms in that snapshot the minimum is also 1. The zero case belongs to the earlier run described in §3.3, not to this one.

_verdict_note: The paper's load-bearing statistics recompute exactly, and I found no blocker. Verified clean against the artifacts, in full: (A) §2.1 — 1,670 models in OmicsFusionFiltered 24Q4, 2 filtered calls, verbatim 'AL158209.1--NEBL' and 'VIM--RPS25', NR4A3 0.941 log2(TPM+1), 83rd percentile (83.1) of 1,673 lines, panel median 0.214; the '16 markers — 15 STR loci plus amelogenin' recount from the 18-line Cellosaurus ST block (one Source(s) header, one duplicate D13S317 allele call) with Cosmic-CLP 907290, DepMap ACH-001519, RCB0508; and '21 Europe PMC records, exactly one mentions NR4A3' (hit_count 21, rows 21, exactly one with a non-empty mentions_nr4a3_alias). (B) §3.4 — every cell of the GSE4303·GPL3290 contrast table to 3 dp and every t to 2 dp (ATR-CHK1 +0.245/3.518 adj +0.062; S-phase +0.311/4.458 adj +0.128; checkpoint +0.256/4.006 adj +0.074; replication stress +0.156/2.421 adj −0.027; ATM +0.113/1.945 adj −0.070; stalled fork +0.145/1.896 adj −0.038; MYC +0.328/4.421; oxphos +0.384/3.952; adipogenesis +0.218/5.081); the readability table's 6/29, 10/6, 4/27, 1/16, 1/3 sample splits and 20,629 (98.2 %) / 27,196 (58.2 %) / 12-of-12 concepts; UniGene 130,056 clusters and 6,365,381 accessions; 630 curated + 37,279 UniGene + 2 cached = 37,911 of 65,180 = 58.2 %; the repaired NCBI chain on GPL6244 (4,303 queried → 4,103 UIDs = 95.4 % → 3,163 linked = 73.5 % → 2,653 genes named) and its five logged elink errors counted 3×502 / 2×IncompleteRead; GPL2937's 2 of 30,433 with ncbi_budget_exhausted_in_elink_at 600; GPL3290 recorded as never queried (ncbi_global_budget_exhausted) and GPL2937 confirmed the only other EST-keyed platform NCBI answered; GSE24369's flat read (ATM −0.004, ATR-CHK1 +0.011, replication stress −0.000, stalled fork −0.009, S-phase +0.044, checkpoint +0.045, max |t| 0.709 ≤ 0.71; MYC +0.084/3.342, oxphos +0.113/5.918, adipogenesis +0.047/2.114; FET-arm checkpoint +0.103/1.735). (§8) 62 accounted for vs 68 deposited (12+12+13+14+11 = 62), the tumour 14/13/12/12/11 and cell-model 2/1/1/1/1 splits, 68/68 SRA + RNA-Seq + transcriptomic + polyA RNA, 67 GPL24676 vs 1 GPL34281 (the EMC model), 68/68 with a Salmon .quant.sf.gz, 0/68 naming an ATR inhibitor and 0/68 with a populated treatment protocol, the ten-gene SARC-HRD signature quoted from the series summary, one fusion term (BCOR-rearranged) across 68 samples, seven FET-fusion sarcoma types listed absent, 54 preprint sentences stored 54, and the whole identity check (ACTB 4,423.6 / GAPDH 2,574.7 / ALB 0.474 / INS 0.000; NR4A3 13.33 TPM rank 4 of 68 at 7.0× the 1.896 median; LMS04 39.51 / SS10 28.79 / LMS12 17.03; NR4A1 196.78 outweighing NR4A3 15×; family fraction 13.33/210.11 = 0.0634, rank 29 of 68 against median 0.0524; 67 samples on a 188,597-row index vs 162,218 rows for the EMC model). (Appendix) The three superseded snapshots verify against git: 12e44660c gives GPL3290 n_accessions_newly_queried 2, n_distinct_accessions 65,180, 662 probes of 41,614, and ncbi_aborted 'too many errors after 4500 accessions' with 0 linked; ce630e2b4 gives 4,303 → 4,303 → 59 linked, n_mapped 20,324, accession_resolution_rate 0.932, and GPL3290 27,195 against the pinned 27,196; a07235aef's author timestamp 23:10:35 is 1 min 41 s after 12e44660c's 23:08:54, so 'two minutes after' holds on author date (its committer date is 21 min later); and atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json fetch_status records mechanism_fulltext_xml 'HTTP 200, 156566 bytes' at fetched_utc 2026-08-27. The series-selection rule reproduces: both readable series tie on the first clause and GSE4303 wins the EMC-sample-count tie-break, 10 > 6.
